cards_note: The full 256x388 card render of every minion and of its golden twin (BgCardDB.lua `golden=`, skipped when HearthstoneJSON has no render), padded top-aligned onto a transparent 256x512 canvas (texcoord bottom = `bottom`), in art/out/BgMinions/cards/<id>.blp; deploy-addon.ps1 copies them into Textures\BgMinions\Cards\ and lists them in HS_BgTextures.cards.
note: One 128x128 oval portrait (BLP2 DXT5 with an elliptic alpha) per Battlegrounds minion card, made by tools/art/bg_minions.py into art/out/BgMinions/<id>.blp; deploy-addon.ps1 copies them into the client's Textures\BgMinions\ and lists the ids in HS_BgTextures (BgTextures.lua). The ids are the engine's own table (src/battlegrounds/HsBgCardData.inc). A golden minion uses its normal twin's portrait with the gold ring (Textures\Bg\golden_ring.blp) drawn over it.
